blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas women’s beach volleyball squads marched into the Asian Games quarterfinals on Monday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. Young stars Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara remained unbeaten in the Aichi-Nagoya games, getting the better of Hong Kong’s Wong Man Ching and Ngok Ling Tsang, 26-24, 21-18, in the round of 16. Southeast Asian Games gold medalists Sisi Rondina and Bernadeth Pons eliminated home bets Sakura Ito and Mayu Sawame, 21-17, 21-15.
